title: 3BR 30A Beachfront Vacation Rental with Panoramic Views
meta_description: Stay at Sun N Surf, a 3BR, 2BA, 30A beachfront vacation home with panoramic views, direct access to the Gulf, a fireplace, and a full kitchen. Sleeps 11.
description_expanded: Sun 'n Surf is an incredible Gulf-front home in Inlet Beach with breathtaking panoramic views and direct access to the Gulf of Mexico. What's better on a 30A vacation than staying at a home with your own private beach! Sun 'n Surf can sleep up to 11 guests and has 3 bedrooms; 1 on the 1st Floor and 2 on the 2nd Floor.You and your guests will build beautiful vacation memories as you experience your own private beach moments and relax on the huge deck overlooking the Emerald Coast waters. Slip your toes in the sugar white sand and enjoy the Florida sunshine. Just bring your sunscreen!The living room has 2-story, floor to ceiling windows with the best breathtaking coastal views. Cozy up in front of the gas fireplace and 60” TV (with cable!) for relaxing night in. The dining room has a beautiful sunset view over the Gulf plus there's space outside on the Gulf-front deck to enjoy a meal outdoors.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, TV and Gulf-front deck access. Attached bathroom with shower.1st Floor, Living Room: Sofa pulls out to a queen bed.2nd Floor, Landing: Twin-over-full bunk bed.2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV. Private Gulf-front balcony.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, TV. Private Gulf-front balcony. Attached bathroom with tub/shower combo.Free Beach Set Up Included:We are thrilled to include a Free Seasonal Beach Set Up with your rental! Grab a seat in style with our free beach chair set up – two comfy chairs and a cool umbrella. You now have one less thing to worry about as you plan out your vacation with Benchmark Management!History of Sun N Surf:Back in the early 1950's, the owner's Dad, “Papa Z” purchased this plot of beach land— it was really untamed, wild and bare bones. Growing from a one room cinder block cabin with hand pump water well, it’s become their favorite family vacation destination, complete with every modern convenience.The owners have been part-time residents of Inlet Beach for many decades now, watching as 30A has become a preferred destination for beach-goers everywhere, visitors who love the restaurants in the area and activities in Rosemary Beach, Alys and Seaside. And most of all, love the sand and surf! We know you will love your vacation at Sun n Surf, and hope you will return year after year to enjoy this special place.Your stay at Sun 'n Surf comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!*Complimentary beach service: 2 chairs/1 umbrella set up from La Dolce Vita provided March-October (weather permitting).* Parking for 4 cars.* Sorry, no pets allowed.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
